name: Morrowgrain Research
label: Quest
description: Morrowgrain Research: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from Un'Goro Crater. These seeds blossom into an array of random, potent herbs. One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I intend to unravel this mystery.
Take this to Mathrengyl downstairs, and he will give you some seeds so you can get started. If you run out, you will need to purchase more from him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Peace and serenity be yours, friend. You are here on business from the Arch Druid himself, yes?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, this voucher is good for twenty packets of seeds. If you run out, we have more that can be provided. Unfortunately though, Tharlendris seeds are quite costly to produce in significant numbers. This is why the Cenarion Circle asks that those who are assisting us help out by offsetting some of the cost.
Those who return with morrowgrain find that the reward the Arch Druid offers far makes up for the cost.
